subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) On the way, people were showing due respect to the statue of the goddess. (b) So, feeling proud, the donkey started to bray in joy. (c) Once a statue of goddess was being taken to the town placing on the back of a donkey. (d) Then the driver of the donkey became very angry. (e) Saying this, he started beating the donkey with his stick.
